notes.title: Free live broadcast of the launch event
notes.notes:
[code]To celebrate the release of this title on Nintendo Switch and Steam, we'll be livestreaming a special event on Sunday, August 31st for free on Steam!

📺Free Livestream Launch Event Overview

Date: Sunday, August 31, 2025

Streaming Time: 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM (scheduled)

Performers: Rin Kurusu, Saku Mizuno, Dan Harusaki, (MC) Naoki Yoshimura

*Some content will be exclusive to the venue.

*This stream will be a live broadcast of the event.

*The stream may be interrupted or canceled without notice depending on the streaming environment and venue conditions. Thank you for your understanding.[/code]

notes.title: 📢 Announcement: Live Stream of the Launch Commemorative Event
notes.notes: [p]To celebrate the release of this title on Nintendo Switch and Steam,[/p][p]we will be streaming the special event held on August 31 (Sun) for free on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]📺 Live Stream Details[/p][p]・Date: Sunday, August 31, 2025[/p][p]・Time: 13:00 – 14:30 (planned, JST)[/p][p]・Guests: Rin Kurusu, Saku Mizuno, Haru Harusaki, (MC) Naoki Yoshimura[/p][p][/p][p]Look forward to exclusive talks and character-focused segments—content fans won’t want to miss! ✨[/p][p]Be sure to tune in live![/p][p][/p][p]※ Some content is exclusive to the venue.[/p][p]※ This stream will broadcast the event as a live relay.[/p][p]※ Depending on the streaming environment or venue conditions, the broadcast may be interrupted or canceled without notice. Please understand in advance.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690420/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Out Now & Theme Song Behind-the-Scenes Video Released✨
notes.notes: [p]The visual novel Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You is now available🌸[/p][p]To celebrate the release, we're holding a 20% OFF launch sale.[/p][p]Don’t miss out on this special offer![/p][p]Additionally, we’ve released a behind-the-scenes video of the theme song "Melody of the Night Sky～Miracle of the Cherry Blossoms～"[/p][p]It features Rin Kurusu, the voice of Cherry, sharing her heartfelt thoughts on the song and the game right after recording. A must-watch for fans✨[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_mr5rgeAtpY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Store Page Major Update ✨ Theme Song & PV Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve made a major update to the Steam store page for our game![/p][p]The key visual, screenshots, and game description have all been refreshed, and new sections introducing the characters and cast have been added.[/p][p]We’ve also released the promotional video (PV) featuring the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky ～Miracle of the Cherry Blossoms～” sung by Rin Kurusu, who voices Cherry![/p][p]Get an early taste of the game’s world through this special video—be sure to check it out! 🌸[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="feOr1gY963I;full"][/previewyoutube]
